sloka: निष्पतन्ति ततः सैन्या हृष्टा रावणचोदिताः ।समये पूर्यमाणस्य वेगा इव महोदधेः ।। ६.४२.३७ ।।।।
transliteration: niṣpatanti tataḥ sainyā hṛṣṭā rāvaṇacoditāḥ ।samaye pūryamāṇasya vegā iva mahodadheḥ ।। 6.42.37 ।।।।

translations.english: Urged by Ravana, the army then joyfully rushed forth swiftly like a great ocean at the time of universal destruction.
